description: A clip refused for lack of free space: run by clip-guard-probe.mjs while MinFreeSpaceMegabytes is above C:'s free space. As viewer2 (download permission, no admin rights), 'Make a clip' in the menu of a range bookmark's card on the details page (its row until 1.6.0 / 2.4.0) shows the server's refusal as a toast, the user's sentence 'Not enough free space on the server for this clip. Ask your server admin.', and nothing is queued; the bookmark is deleted again.

steps.name: find Long Test Movie
steps.eval: (await ApiClient.getItems(ApiClient.getCurrentUserId(), { IncludeItemTypes: 'Movie', Recursive: true, SearchTerm: 'Long Test Movie', Limit: 1 })).Items[0].Id

steps.name: a range bookmark 0:50-0:55 of viewer2's
steps.script: const b = await ApiClient.ajax({ type: 'POST', url: ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks'), data: JSON.stringify({ ItemId: __vars.movieId, StartTicks: 500000000, EndTicks: 550000000, Note: 'clip-guard-probe ui' }), contentType: 'application/json', dataType: 'json' }); return b.Id;

steps.name: Make a clip, from the card's menu
steps.script: const c = document.querySelector('#itemDetailPage:not(.hide) .jfbm-bookmark-card[data-jfbm-card="' + __vars.bookmarkId + '"]'); if (!c) throw new Error('no such card'); const more = c.querySelector('.cardOverlayButton-br button, button.cardOverlayButton-br'); if (more) { more.click(); } else { c.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('contextmenu', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true })); } const items = [...document.querySelectorAll('.jfbm-backdrop .jfbm-row-menu-item')]; const b = items.find((x) => x.lastElementChild.textContent === 'Make a clip'); if (!b) throw new Error('no Make a clip in the card menu: ' + items.map((x) => x.lastElementChild.textContent).join(', ')); if (b.disabled) throw new Error('Make a clip is disabled'); b.click(); return true;

steps.name: the refusal as a toast: the user's sentence, no drive or numbers
steps.waitFor: [...document.querySelectorAll('.jfbm-toast')].some(t => t.textContent === 'Not enough free space on the server for this clip. Ask your server admin.')

steps.name: delete the bookmark again
steps.script: await ApiClient.ajax({ type: 'DELETE', url: ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks/' + __vars.bookmarkId) }); return true;

steps.name: no uncaught exceptions (the stale CustomRatings tag excepted)
